newDialog.title: What kind of conversation?
newDialog.description: The choice applies to the whole chat and cannot be changed.

anon.title: Anonymised chat
anon.l1: Every message and every attachment is anonymised before it leaves.
anon.l2: The model receives placeholders; you see the real values.
anon.l3: Documents with extractable text only: no images or scans.

plain.title: Standard chat
plain.l1: Messages and attachments leave as they are, with no anonymisation.
plain.l3: Use only for content that can leave as it is.
plain.required: Disabled by the administrator: in this installation chats must always be anonymized.

anonProgress.heading: Anonymising — {{current}} of {{total}}
anonProgress.footer: Nothing leaves before it finishes: the model will only get placeholders.

ocr.title: Images found in the attachments
ocr.found_one: One image was found in the attachments of this message.
ocr.found_other: {{count}} images were found in the attachments of this message.
ocr.question: Do you want to use OCR to analyse them and cover the sensitive information found inside? It takes a few extra seconds per page. Without OCR the images stay as they were (and image attachments or scans cannot be sent).

merge.title: Entities to merge?
merge.description: Anonymisation has finished and nothing has left yet. The detector kept these entities apart, but they could be the same: deciding now, the model knows it for this very message. The files are not touched — it is the system message that says the two placeholders mean the same entity.
